usage: Ngok6 fu6 is a noun used to refer to the father of one's spouse.
It is typically used in formal or respectful contexts when talking about your wife's or husband's father.
You can use ngok6 fu6 as the subject or object in a sentence.
When addressing your father-in-law directly, you might use other respectful terms instead of ngok6 fu6.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 tung4 ngok6 fu6 sik6 faan6.
examples.meaning: I am going to have a meal with my father-in-law today.
My father-in-law likes me very much.

examples.jyutping: nei5 ngok6 fu6 hai6 bin1 go3?
ngok6 fu6 sung3 zo2 zoeng1 lai5 mat6 bei2 ngo5.
examples.meaning: My father-in-law gave me a gift.
